change: H2 — Keep original text spellings when a SQL sort spills to disk
deployment: Complete pinned H2 engine on the JDBC-only production path, with its embedded driver and storage engine.
assumptions: Fresh disk database, explicit memory-row limit, materialized sort and new JDBC connection. Ignore collation tie order, retain spellings and multiplicity.

questions.observer: Record the SQL DISTINCT count and the exact spelling multiset from the reopened report.
questions.basis: The historical spill representation coalesces equal case-insensitive strings using the first spelling. The fixed report preserves the input multiset.

questions.observer: Repeat the readback with the in-memory sort and the spilled case-sensitive column.
questions.basis: The memory path preserves all spellings. Case-sensitive comparison produces four distinct values.
